items.title: Hyderabad: EFLU students detained for protesting talk by Telangana RSS leader
items.summary: Follow TNM's WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. Twelve students, including six leaders of the Student Union belonging to Hyderabad’s English and Foreign Languages University (EFLU), were placed in preventive detention on Wednesday, September 30. The students were protesting against a talk by Telangana RSS prant pracharak Lingam Sridhar at the university. A member of the student union told TNM that they staged a protest after the EFLU administration refused to revoke permission for the programme. The EFLU student union of parties, including Fraternity Movement, Muslim Students Federation (MSF) and the National Students Union of India (NSUI), were protesting against a talk organised by another group on campus: Bhagat Singh Youth Club. The talk between 4:30 and 7:00 pm was organised under the banner of Yuva Sankalp: Empowering Youth for Nation Building. The Department of Russian Studies’ head of department Professor Satyabhan Singh Rajput, Vivekananda Youth Forum member Vinit Vaddepally and Telangana RSS prant pracharak Lingam Sridhar were scheduled to speak. items.title: A Fundamental Right
items.summary: With its new law that makes education a fundamental right with effect from April 1, 2010, India joins a small group of countries with such a statutory provision. All children in the 6 to 14 age group can exercise the right under the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009. An estimated one crore children who do not go to school now are expected to benefit.
